extDescription.message: Shows all messages of a conversation in the message pane: newest pinned on top, older ones below.

remoteBlocked.message: To protect your privacy, remote content in this message has been blocked.

optPin.message: Pin the newest message while scrolling (newest first only)

optMaxHeight.message: Maximum height of the pinned message (% of window)

optExpandLatestPrev.message: Newest, the one before it, and unread ones

optAlwaysRender.message: Also show single messages in this view

optAlwaysRenderHint.message: Off: messages without replies keep the standard display.

optHideHeader.message: Hide Betterbird's standard message header and attachment bar

optHideHeaderHint.message: Only while this view is shown. Single messages keep the standard header.

loadFailed.message: This message could not be loaded.

notDownloaded.message: Not downloaded yet – loads when opened

optFallback.message: When a message has no reply chain

optFallbackSmart.message: Group by subject with extra rules

optFallbackHint.message: Reply chains (Message-ID, References, In-Reply-To) are always used first. The fallback applies only to messages without a chain.

optFallbackDays.message: Extra rules: maximum distance in days

optFallbackPeople.message: Extra rules: at least one shared sender or recipient

optDebugTiming.message: Write timings to the error console

optDebugTimingHint.message: For troubleshooting: shows how long searching, loading and building take (Ctrl+Shift+J).

optEngineAuto.message: Automatic (NovaBird-DB, then Gloda, then Betterbird's search)

optEngineHint.message: The NovaBird-DB index finds conversations in a few milliseconds. If it is missing, still indexing or does not answer, Gloda (Betterbird's own index) is tried, then Betterbird's search. The grouping rules for messages without a reply chain apply to NovaBird-DB and the search; Gloda uses its own.

optStyleSoftDesc.message: Rounded cards with avatars, lots of air.

optStyleClearDesc.message: Flat rows with thin lines, more text per screen.

optStyleThreadDesc.message: Timeline with dots, your own messages tinted.

deleteTip.message: Move this message to the trash

optAutoOpen.message: Open the row under the pointer when scrolling

optAutoOpenHint.message: A collapsed row opens when the pointer rests on it (depending on the choice only after scrolling, or also without). Nothing opens while you are still scrolling. With IMAP the text is then fetched.

optAutoOpenTrHover.message: Also when the pointer just rests

optOpenMs.message: Duration of the opening animation (ms, 0 = off)

optFadeMs.message: Fade-in when a conversation loads (ms, 0 = off)

optRowLines.message: Lines of preview text for collapsed messages

spamTip.message: Mark as spam and move to the spam folder

notSpamTip.message: Mark as not spam and move to the inbox

optStickyHeader.message: Keep the header in view while scrolling long messages (Soft and Clear styles)

optAutoOriginal.message: Show unreadable single messages in the original view automatically

optAutoOriginalHint.message: If the view of a single message shows hardly any text although the message contains a lot, Betterbird’s original view is shown instead.

hintLimit.message: The maximum number of messages loaded from the index per conversation. This limits large newsletter groups with many identical subjects; higher values take a little longer.

hintOrder.message: Newest first shows the latest reply on top; Oldest first reads like a conversation from top to bottom.

hintPin.message: The newest message stays on top while you scroll through older ones. If it is taller than the height below, “Show all” opens it fully.

hintExpand.message: Which messages appear expanded when a conversation opens. Unread and the selected message are always open; all others show a row with a preview.

hintAttachments.message: Where the attachment chips appear in each message: above the text you see them at once, below the text they do not interrupt reading.

hintQuotes.message: Quoted replies are hidden behind “…”. A click shows the quoted text.

hintSticky.message: While reading a long message, sender, date and buttons stay in view at the top until the message ends.

hintRowLines.message: How many lines of preview text a collapsed message shows (1–6). More lines = more content, fewer messages at once.

hintOpenMs.message: Duration of the animation when a message opens or closes. 0 turns it off; the system setting “Reduce motion” is respected.

hintFadeMs.message: How long the conversation fades in while loading. 0 shows it at once; short values avoid flicker.

capExpand.message: Open: newest, the one before, unread

selfTestText.message: This version does not fully match $APP$. The following is therefore switched off:

selfTestHint.message: Everything else works normally. A newer version of the add-on usually fixes this.

selfTest_threadHook.message: Conversation for collapsed threads (Betterbird’s thread summary is shown instead)

selfTest_displayedMessage.message: Conversation when several messages are selected

selfTest_gloda.message: Lookup via the Gloda index (fallback without NovaBird-DB)

otherConvText.message: “Thunderbird Conversations” is also active. Both add-ons hook into the message display and get in each other’s way; it is better to use only one of them.

otherConvDone.message: Thunderbird Conversations is disabled (you can enable it again in the add-ons manager at any time). Restarting Betterbird is recommended.

selfTest_noFlicker.message: Hiding the reading pane while switching messages (the original may flash briefly)
